steps.title: Start here
steps.body: Everything in Constellation hangs off this rail. It never moves, and it's on every screen — so if you're ever lost, you're one click from home.

compact.body: Everything in Constellation hangs off this bar. It's at the bottom of every screen — so if you're ever lost, you're one tap from home.

steps.title: You're on the dashboard
steps.body: This is your landing page — not the club's, yours. Everything on it is filtered to what you're actually involved in.

compact.title: You're on Home
compact.body: Home is your landing page — not the club's, yours. Everything on it is filtered to what you're actually involved in.

steps.title: XP and doubloons
steps.body: Your rank progress and your spendable balance, always in the sidebar. We'll come back to what earns each one in module 4.

compact.body: Your rank progress and your spendable balance. On a phone they sit at the top of More. We'll come back to what earns each one in module 4.

steps.title: What's on you
steps.body: Every task assigned to you, across every project, in one list. If you only ever look at one thing in Constellation, make it this.

steps.title: The next seven days
steps.body: Due dates and meetings, together. This is the panel that stops a deadline from surprising you.

compact.body: Expand the 7-day agenda when you need the week beyond the Next event card.

steps.title: Open your notifications
steps.body: Go ahead and click the bell. This is the complete record of everything that's wanted your attention.

compact.body: Go ahead and tap the bell. It opens the complete record of everything that's wanted your attention.

steps.title: Your streak
steps.body: Consecutive days you've done something real in Constellation. It resets at 2am — and no, opening the app doesn't count.

compact.body: Consecutive days you've done something real in Constellation — on a phone it's with your progress in More. It resets at 2am — and no, opening the app doesn't count.

steps.title: That's the lap
steps.body: Projects are where the actual work lives, and that's where we're headed next — on a private practice project we'll set up just for you.

compact.body: Projects are where the actual work lives — this button lists every one you can open. That's where we're headed next, on a private practice project we'll set up just for you.
